description: Skills, rules, snippets and templates that keep AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) writing correct Blender Python for 5.2 LTS and 4.5 LTS, backed by runnable examples that are smoke-tested on both versions.
ogImageAlt: Four renders from the examples gallery: a red low-poly hatchback, a soccer ball, gold spikes aimed at a glowing sphere, and two spheres on pedestals labelled linked and unlinked
installSteps: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add TMHSDigital/Blender-Developer-Tools@plugin-dist then /plugin install blender-developer-tools@blender-developer-tools. The 20 skills load when a task matches; the rules come along as the blender-rules skill

Cursor: git clone --branch plugin-dist --single-branch https://github.com/TMHSDigital/Blender-Developer-Tools.git ~/.cursor/plugins/local/blender-developer-tools, then reload the window; Customize lists the 20 skills and 11 rules, and the plugin applies the rules for you. This clones only the 0.3 MB plugin build, not main

Other agents (Codex, Copilot, Windsurf): clone the same slim build (git clone --branch plugin-dist --single-branch https://github.com/TMHSDigital/Blender-Developer-Tools.git) and copy its skills/* into .agents/skills/, append agents/AGENTS.md to your project's AGENTS.md for the rules, and for Copilot copy agents/copilot/blender-python.instructions.md into .github/instructions/

Optional, live session: /plugin install blender-live-session@blender-developer-tools adds the official Blender Lab MCP server (needs uv and Blender 5.1+ with its add-on) so the agent can inspect and drive your open scene, plus a skill that has it read before it mutates and prove changes headless. See the README's Live Blender session
Grab snippets/ and templates/ as starting points for add-ons and headless batch jobs
